title: Toppoint Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Toppoint Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026 reporting director and executive departures (Ms. Florence Ng, Ms. Tan Ying Lo, Mr. Kah Loong Randy Yeo) on April 10-13, 2026, followed by appointments of Ms. Tianheng Li as director and CFO and Ms. Pei Zhang as CFO and director. All resignations cited personal reasons with no stated disagreement with company operations.
key_points: Ms. Florence Ng resigned as director and Board committee member effective April 10, 2026 (personal reasons, no disagreement stated)
Ms. Tan Ying Lo resigned as director and Board committee member effective April 13, 2026 (personal reasons, no disagreement stated)
Mr. Kah Loong Randy Yeo resigned as interim CFO effective April 13, 2026 (personal reasons, no disagreement stated)
Ms. Tianheng Li appointed as director, Audit Committee member, Compensation Committee chair, and Nominating Committee chair effective April 13, 2026
Ms. Pei Zhang appointed as CFO and director on April 13, 2026 (filing truncated)
Company is incorporated in Nevada, trading on NYSE American under symbol TOPP, Commission File Number 001-42471
